project.name: erpnext-domain-logic
project.system_context: Computational domain engine representing the accounting, manufacturing, and inventory systems. Target Stack: rust_decimal = "=1.42.0" (with maths enabled), SurrealDB 3.1.3, Chrono 0.4.
project.directory_structure: erpnext-domain/ ├── Cargo.toml └── crates/ ├── erp-accounting/ # Double-entry postings, composite rollups │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── posting.rs │ └── balance_sheet.rs ├── erp-inventory/ # FIFO stock ledger, stock transfers │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── stock_ledger.rs │ └── transfers.rs ├── erp-manufacturing/ # Recursive BOM cost rollups, MRP demand/supply pipelines │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── bom.rs │ └── mrp.rs ├── erp-hr/ # Payroll, attendance, and HR functions │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── payroll.rs │ └── attendance.rs ├── erp-crm/ # Lead scoring and sales pipeline │ └── src/ │ ├── lib.rs │ ├── lead_scoring.rs │ └── pipeline.rs

key_invariants.invariant: All arithmetic for balances, tax rates, routing costs, and values must use high-precision rust_decimal::Decimal to prevent float drift.

SurrealDB v3 uses surrealdb::types::RecordId (re-exported from surrealdb-types). The RecordId struct does not implement Display; use .to_sql() from surrealdb::types::ToSql to insert it into SQL statements.
Recursive BOM costing must expand Phantom BOM nodes inline. Routing costs must be summed recursively alongside components.
Salary components are evaluated dynamically using the Rhai scripting engine. Formulas must be valid Rhai expressions.
